children.translated_text: Oṃ! Salutation to the <s>Netratantra</s>!
who is the cause of the creation, maintenance, and dissolution of the universe,
To the one whose domain is directly perceptible reality, whose purpose is the welfare of the world,
to you, the source of the three worlds, O <s>Śiva</s>, salutation!
who is the self of all, who has conquered anger and desire,
